{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows with invalid revenue
sales_df_clean = sales_df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df_clean[sales_df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute and print the number of completed orders and their mean revenue
num_completed = len(completed_orders)
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

print(num_completed)
print(mean_revenue)"}
